title: Quality-gate success record (build-pass)
description: Appended by feature-implementer when the quality gate — the command and verb vocabulary are declared in scripts/layout.toml [gate] — passes. Replaces the legacy 'delete build-failure.md on success' semantics: append-only requires an explicit success marker so the coordinator can route to reviewers based on the latest build-* record being a pass. The retry trail (preceding build-failure records) is preserved for diagnostic purposes.

gate_checks_run.description: Which gate verbs ran and passed. Required: build-pass gates the reviewer fan-out, so the record carries a machine-checkable trace of the gate sequence — a build-failure names its failed_check for the same reason. The verb vocabulary is the project's layout.toml [gate] verbs (enumFrom); with no [gate] table the vocabulary check is skipped, never blocking.

duration_seconds.description: Wall-clock time spent in the gate. Optional, useful for monitoring.
